Aliases: CVE-2026-116581

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H

Affected:

  • seroval — fixed in 1.6.8

### Summary `fromJSON` and `fromCrossJSON` used two node fields without checking them. - An array node's element list was not checked to be an array. entry.title: [NEW] GHSA-wp97-x4hv-qvhp: Seroval `fromJSON`/`fromCrossJSON` denial of service via unvalidated array node length

Seroval `fromJSON`/`fromCrossJSON` denial of service via unvalidated array node length

Aliases: CVE-2026-116584

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H

Affected:

  • seroval — fixed in 1.6.8

### Summary `fromJSON` and `fromCrossJSON` did not check that an array node's element list is an array. A small crafted payload could set the length the decoder used. This affects any framework that decodes request bodies with these functions before its own validation runs. This issue is a bypass of the fix for GHSA-66fc-rw6m-c2q6 in 1.4.1. ### Patches Fixed in `seroval@1.6.8`.…
